method.admission: Abort on fixture lineage/world/revision, Agreement identity/version/status, complete source terms, participant identity, calendar source fingerprint or accepted interval drift. The existing writer checks current worker conflicts under its serialization fence.
method.repair: Only the existing one-row calendar projection was reacquired as BLOCKING; the canonical writer owns its projection timestamp/fence.
method.idempotent_replay: The same guarded command sees the already correct BLOCKING state and returns before invoking the writer. Exact postimage (including the calendar timestamp) is unchanged.
